name: Tent - YMG 1P Cirriform

places.why: tent body in its sack across the bars in the bar roll; bulky, light enough to steer with, and the first thing out at camp
in a cargo cage on the fork with two straps; splits the tent off the bars and keeps weight low
deep in the seat pack when the bars are full; a short bikepack-length sack fits a 10-14 L pack

sources.what: maker of the Cirriform; weight is the owner's own figure, not a maker spec

note: Owner's item: 20.8 oz (590 g) is his figure. The owner's sheet describes the YMG Cirriform as a UK-made 1-person shelter; my recollection is that YMG is Yama Mountain Gear of Virginia, USA, so the origin needs checking. It is a trekking-pole-pitched single-person shelter, so no dedicated poles are in this weight (see tent-poles). Packed size estimated from comparable 1P trekking-pole shelters (Six Moon Lunar Solo, Zpacks Plex Solo); packed_l as cylinder.
